svg.title: How the initramfs script decides whether to run dracut
svg.desc: For every kernel the script computes a fingerprint of what decides which files dracut takes. Without a cache entry for that fingerprint it runs dracut and stores the result. With one, it checks every file the cached initramfs contains against the system; if one of them changed, it runs dracut too. Otherwise it takes the cached initramfs. It writes the initramfs only when it differs from the one in place.
